"''I don't know, you've never been to a Mynock roast on Ardennia. It's nuts!|Tobias Beckett and Rio Durant|}} '''Ardennia''' was an [[Outer Rim Territories]] [[planet]] that was the [[homeworld]] of the [[Sentience|sentient]] [[Ardennian]] [[species]]. The [[human]] [[Juronus Opto]] and the [[Wayuning]] [[Topi Topi]] were also native to that world, and the inhabitants of Ardennia held repeated events known as [[Mynock roast]]s. The latter fact was known to the Ardennian [[pilot]] and [[thief]] [[Rio Durant]], who hailed from Ardennia as well. ==Description== Ardennia was a terrestrial [[planet]]''[[Star Wars Bestiary, Vol. 1: Creatures of the Galaxy]]'' located in the [[Ardennia system]] of the [[Fath sector]], a part of the [[Outer Rim Territories]] and the [[New Territories]]. Situated within grid square K-6 of the [[Standard Galactic Grid]], it was connected via the [[Entralla Route]] [[hyperspace route]] to the [[Carlac system]] as well as the [[Mid Rim Territories|Mid Rim's]] [[Orinda system]]. Ardennia also shared its name with the [[Ardennian Guild of Technicians]] that was active during the [[High Republic Era]].''[[The High Republic: The Rising Storm]]'' ==History== [[File:Rio_Durant_SoloTOCE.png|thumb|left|300px|Ardennia was the homeworld of the Ardennians, including Rio Durant (pictured).]] Ardennia's [[Homeworld|native]] [[Sentience|sentient]] [[species]], the [[Ardennian]]s, were already known off-world''[[The High Republic: Quest for Planet X]]'' by [[382 BBY]].''[[Star Wars: The High Republic Character Encyclopedia]]'' dates the events of ''[[The High Republic: Quest for Planet X]]'' to [[382 BBY]]. [[Rio Durant]], an Ardennian [[pilot]] and [[thief]] who had served with the [[Galactic Republic]]-aligned [[Freedom's Sons]] [[army]] during the [[Clone Wars]]''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story The Official Guide]]'' of [[22 BBY]]–[[19 BBY]],''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' hailed from Ardennia. In [[10 BBY]], during an attempted [[Heist on Vandor|theft]] of a shipment of valuable refined [[coaxium]] from a [[Galactic Empire]] [[20-T Railcrawler conveyex transport]] on the planet [[Vandor]], the [[human]] [[Tobias Beckett]], the leader of the [[Beckett's gang|crew]] of criminals that Durant was a part of, excitedly declared that their upcoming haul would render that [[Standard day|day]] the best of the Ardennian's life. In response, Durant quipped that he was not sure about that since Beckett had never participated in a [[Mynock roast]] event on Ardennia. Ardennia was also the homeworld of the human [[Juronus Opto]] and the [[Wayuning]] [[Topi Topi]], which was noted in the postings of [[Bounty|bounties]] issued for them by the [[time]] of the [[First Order]] [[Battle of Batuu|occupation]] of the planet [[Batuu]]{{DatapadCite|''[[Star Wars: Batuu Bounty Hunters]]''|BatuuBountyHunters-JuronusOpto.png|BatuuBountyHunters-TopiTopi.png}} in [[34 ABY]].''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the events of [[Star Wars: Galaxy's Edge|''Star Wars'': Galaxy's Edge]], which includes those of ''[[Star Wars: Batuu Bounty Hunters]]'', to [[34 ABY]]. At some point, Ardennia was also mentioned in an entry of an [[Unidentified artist|artist's]] [[Unidentified artist's journal|journal]] dedicated to the Ardennians. The entry was included in a section of the [[Book|work]] describing sentient species that originated in [[Water|wet]] habitats. The journal was restored, expanded, and displayed at the [[Graf Archive]] at some point no earlier than 34 [['ABY-BBY' dating system|ABY]].{{AlienArchiveJournalDate}} In addition, the Mynock roasts of Ardennia were noted in the [[Ardis San Tekka's journal|journal]] of the [[Galactic Society of Creature Enthusiasts]] [[cartographer]] [[Ardis San Tekka]], which was published at some point no earlier than [[35 ABY]].{{BestiaryVol1Date}} ==Inhabitants== {{Quote|Mynock roasts are a popular form of entertainment on planets such as Ardennia ''[…]''|Ardis San Tekka's journal|}} [[File:TopiTopi-SWBH.png|thumb|right|220px|The Wayuning Topi Topi, a native of Ardennia]] Ardennia was the homeworld of the Ardennian species, members of which had four [[Limb|arms]] as well as prehensile toes on their two feet. The natives of the planet also included the human Juronus Opto and the Wayuning Topi Topi. Ardennia's inhabitants repeatedly held events known as Mynock roasts, which the Ardennian Rio Durant once described as "nuts." The events involved the [[Foodstuff|cooking]] of [[mynock]]s—[[Diet|edible]], [[silicon]]-based, ergovorous creatures that originated from the planet [[Ord Mynock]]{{GEAttr|Creature Stall}} and could survive in deep [[Realspace|space]] as well as in planetary surface conditions. ==Behind the scenes== Ardennia was first mentioned in the [[2018]] ''[[Star Wars Anthology Series]]'' film ''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story]]''. ==Appearances== *''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story]]'' {{1stm}} *[[Solo: A Star Wars Story Adaptation 2|''Solo: A Star Wars Story Adaptation'' 2]] {{Mo}} *{{DatapadCite|''[[Star Wars: Batuu Bounty Hunters]]''|BatuuBountyHunters-JuronusOpto.png|BatuuBountyHunters-TopiTopi.png}} {{Mo}} ==Sources== {{Mediacat|imagecat=Images of Ardennia}} *''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story The Official Guide]]'' *''[[Star Wars: Alien Archive]]'' *''[[Star Wars Character Encyclopedia, New Edition]]'' *''[[Ultimate Star Wars, New Edition]]'' *{{EncyclopediaCite|Tobias Beckett and Other Characters of the Underworld}} *''[[Star Wars: Character Encyclopedia, Updated and Expanded Edition]]'' *{{GalaxyMapPoster}} {{MapPoint}} *''[[Star Wars Bestiary, Vol. 1: Creatures of the Galaxy]]'' *''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia: The Comprehensive Guide to the Star Wars Galaxy]]'' *''[[Star Wars: Complete Locations, New Edition]]'' {{MapPoint}} *{{StarWarsGalaxyMap}} {{MapPoint}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |cs=Ardennia |es=Ardennia |fr=Ardennia |ja=アルデニア |ka=არდენია |pl=Ardennia }} [[Category:Fath sector locations]] [[Category:Locations along the Entralla Route]] [[Category:Planets in the New Territories]] [[Category:Planets in the Outer Rim Territories]] [[Category:Terrestrial planets]]
